name: uberdev
description: GitHub workflow commands: /solve spawns autonomous agents in cmux/Ghostty/iTerm to solve issues with tier-aware triage; /issue creates well-investigated, deduped, label-validated issues. Bundles workflow skills (brainstorm, write-plan, execute-plan, subagent-driven-dev) and PR review agents (code-reviewer, code-simplifier, comment-analyzer, pr-test-analyzer, silent-failure-hunter, type-design-analyzer) so /solve runs standalone.
